data.desc: EVI Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: EVI), through its subsidiaries, operates in the commercial laundry distribution and consumer garment care services industries. EVI's commercial laundry businesses sell or lease equipment, supply parts and accessories, and provide design, installation, maintenance, repair and related services to commercial, industrial, institutional, governmental and retail customers. EVI's consumer garment care operations provide cleaning, pressing, alteration, restoration and related services for apparel and household textiles through retail and pickup-and-delivery operations. The Company pursues a long-term buy-and-build strategy focused on developing businesses, investing in people and capabilities, and creating shareholder value.
